theorem divided_shell (t h z : Int) (s : Nat) :
    let p := 2*t+1
    let a := p+1+4*h
    let k := 2*z+1
    let d := shell p a k (s+1)-shell p a k s
    2 ∣ d ∧ d/2 % 2 = (a-k-1)/2 % 2 := by
